name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.34.2: screenshots recaptured with the real typefaces, and favicons that actually exist. Two corrections to 6.34.1. First, the captures in 6.34.1 were taken with system fallback fonts: curl reaches Google Fonts through the sandbox egress proxy but Chromium does not, so every webfont request failed silently and the screenshots were not of the product - wrong serif, wrong sans, wrong numerals. The stylesheet and all 21 woff2 files are now fetched with curl and served to the page from disk, and the capture asserts document.fonts.check for Geist, Geist Mono and Cormorant Garamond italic before each shot, so a future run fails loudly instead of quietly shipping Times New Roman as the brand serif. Second, index.html has referenced /favicon_light.png, /favicon_dark.png and an apple-touch-icon since before this work, and public/ contained no favicon at all, so all three 404ed in production; features.html inherited the same three dead references. Both files are now generated from the AG mark already embedded in the dashboard CSS, cropped to the AG letterforms rather than the full frame glyph because the frame turns to mush at 16px, ink on cream for light (which also serves as the apple-touch tile, where transparency would render black) and cream on transparent for dark. Cumulative over v6.34.1.
